exact_header.name: NLA.SP15.constructed_kernel_flag
exact_header.header:
theorem constructed_kernel_flag (x : Parameters) (hx : x ∈ parameterBox) :
    (∀ v : BlockIndex → ℂ,
      (blockMatrix x).mulVec v = 0 ↔
        (∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inl i)) = 0) ∧
        (∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) = 0)) ∧
    (∀ v : BlockIndex → ℂ,
      (blockMatrix x ^ 2).mulVec v = 0 ↔
        ∀ i : Fin 3, v (Sum.inr (Sum.inr i)) = 0)

numerical_target: No new numerical computation. Prove actual Av=(Rv2,Sv3,0), A²v=(RSv3,0,0); use genuine root-unit injectivity. Both exact kernel equivalences for every complex vector.
implementation_refinement: Obtain A² action by mulVec_mulVec and two uses of the actual Av formula; avoids a second standalone matrix block square expansion. No mathematical target change.
